name: Ali Dunford
occupation: Teton County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results). The Jackson Hole News&Guide reported that she said she started Hole Food Rescue.
background: Ali Dunford is a Teton County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Mark Newcomb, who is serving through December 31, 2026. The Jackson Hole News&Guide reported that she was the top vote-getter in the three-seat race with 6,227 votes and quoted her as saying that she started Hole Food Rescue.

sources.name: Jackson Hole News&Guide, Nov. 4, 2026, Dunford, Propst and Chin elected to Teton County Commission
